name: Brethren
description: Brethren are the crazed human followers of the cults of the dark gods, eager to descend into damnation.

name: Darksoul
description: Hollowed out by daemonic possession, these revered warriors serve as the holy enforcers of the cult, carrying out their bloody craft without fear.

name: Magister
description: The cult magister is a charismatic and brilliant individual, who bends lesser souls to their will through dark pacts and a silver tongue.

choose.prompt: When recruiting this fighter, you must select one of the following abilities:

name: Mutant
description: Hollowed out by daemonic possession, these revered warriors have become instruments of violence, free from fear or mercy.

name: Possessed
description: The Possessed have committed the greatest of sins: they have given their bodies to Daemons. They are nightmarish creatures made of flesh and black magic.
